    charge_durations close_attack_anim_damage_timing close_attack_anim_duration consume_durations

    drag_anim_exit_delay duration end_durations execute_duration execute_timing fire_timing
    grab_anim_duration heal_durations melee_attack_rotation_durations miss_durations move_durations
    reached_destination_durations rotation_duration rotation_durations scope_reflection_timing_before_shooting
    scope_reflection_timing_effect_template scope_reflection_timing_sfx shoot_timing smash_anim_duration

    in_sight_duration_shoot_requirement lost_los_fail_duration time_per_shot
    reload_duration switch_weapon_duration malfunction_duration]])

    projectile_template liquid_template effect_template attack_intensities utility_weight utility_weights]])
local function factor(key,native_melee,kind,name,rate)
    if kind=="native" then return end
    if mixed_timings[name] then
        if mixed_timings[name][key] then return key=="place_liquid_timing_speed" and (rate or ATTACK) or 1/(rate or ATTACK) end
        return

    -- durations/distances. A navigation multiplier is not a traversal clock.
    if kind=="move" then return end
    if name=="BtBlockedAction" then return end -- Native recovery already reads melee_attack_speed.
    -- Shared shooting divides these delays by ranged_attack_speed itself.
    -- Keep the source values intact; the shooting hook supplies the one rate.
    if shared_shoot_nodes[name] and (key=="shoot_timing" or key=="first_shoot_timing" or key=="time_per_shot") then return end
    if key:find("cooldown",1,true) then return 1/(rate or ATTACK) end

end
local function action_copy(data,native_melee,kind,name,rate,seen)
    kind=kind or "attack"

    seen=seen or {};if seen[data] then return end;seen[data]=true
    local changed=false;local copy={}
    for key,value in pairs(data)do
        local f=type(key)=="string" and factor(key,native_melee,kind,name,rate)
        if f and (type(value)=="table" or type(value)=="number") then copy[key]=scale_numbers(value,f);changed=true
        elseif type(value)=="table" and not untouched_tables[key] then
            local nested=action_copy(value,native_melee,kind,name,rate,seen);copy[key]=nested or value;changed=changed or nested~=nil
        else copy[key]=value end
    end

    -- present. Supply it on the private copy so that path is accelerated too.
    if kind=="attack" and data.throw_timings and data.throw_config and not data.cooldown then
        copy.cooldown=scale_numbers(Difficulty.cooldowns.grenadier_throw,1/(rate or ATTACK));changed=true
    end

end
local function controller(state,unit,breed)
    local current=state.current
    if not current or not current.active or not mod.has_local_gameplay_authority()
        or not Managers.state or Managers.state.game_session~=current.session then return end
    if not breed then
        local data=ScriptUnit.has_extension(unit,"unit_data_system")
        breed=data and data:breed()
    end
    if breed and breed.breed_type=="minion" then return current end
end

    assert(available,"Frenzied assault: "..tostring(why))

local function activate(ctx)
    local state=install_hooks()

        moves=weak(),trees=weak(),action_copy=action_copy,log=function(message)ctx:log(message)end}

        if name~="BtMeleeAttackAction" and name~="BtBlockedAction" and not ranged_nodes[name] then return ATTACK end

        local speed=stats and stats[ranged_nodes[name] and "ranged_attack_speed" or "melee_attack_speed"]
        return speed and speed>0 and speed or (ranged_nodes[name] and RANGED or ATTACK)
    end

        local kind,name=node_kind(brain._running_leaf_node)
        if kind=="native" then return 1 end

        if record and live_extension(brain._unit,"navigation_system",record.nav) and record.nav:is_using_smart_object() then return 1 end

        if name=="BtPoxwalkerBomberApproachAction" and pad.state=="lunging" then return ATTACK end
        if pad.state=="in_air_stagger" or pad.state=="falling" or pad.running_stagger_duration or pad.stagger_duration then return 1 end
        if name=="BtInCoverAction" then
            if pad.state=="entering" or pad.state=="suppressed" then return 1 end
            return record and record.attack_rate or RANGED
        end
        if name=="BtDashAction" or name=="BtRenegadeFlamerPatrolAction" and pad.shoot_state then return ATTACK end
        if kind=="move" then
            -- Authored start/stop/root-driven intervals keep their native
            -- clock. Once moving, this also covers constant-speed clips and
            -- custom blends which never read anim_move_speed.
            if pad.is_anim_driven or pad.start_move_event_anim_speed_duration
                or pad.behavior_component and pad.behavior_component.move_state=="idle" then return 1 end

        end

            if pad.state=="charging" or pad.state=="navigating" then
                if name=="BtMutantChargerChargeAction" and pad.current_charge_speed
                    and not pad.is_anim_driven and not pad.anim_move_speed_duration then
                    local data=brain._running_leaf_node.tree_node.action_data
                    local ratio=pad.current_charge_speed/data.animation_charge_speed
                    local native_variable=math.clamp(ratio,data.min_animation_variable,data.max_animation_variable)

end

-- Select per-unit policy; native evaluation advances clocks, blends,
-- events and root motion with scaled dt. No per-layer seeks or getters.
local Native=require("./native_timestep.lua")
local A={cleanup=Native.cleanup}
function A.available()
    local ok,why=Native.available()
    if ok then Native.complete_trace()end -- Disable diagnostic atomic writes from the first frame.
    return ok,why
end
local function add(current,unit,rate,brain)
    local seen,records=current.animation_seen,current.animation_records
    if not unit or not ALIVE[unit] or seen[unit] or not Unit.has_animation_state_machine(unit) then return end
    seen[unit]=true
    local record=records[unit] or {};records[unit]=record
    local binding,why=Native.bind(unit,rate,record)
    if not binding and current.log and record.last_error~=why then
        record.last_error=why
        local node=brain and brain._running_leaf_node
        local label=(brain and brain._breed and brain._breed.name or "unknown").."/"..(node and node.tree_node[1] or "unknown")
        current.log("[Frenzied assault] native_timestep=binding_failed unit_action="..label.." reason="..tostring(why))
    end
end
function A.before(current,world,dt)
    if dt<=0 or world~=current.world or not World.get_data(world,"active") or World.get_data(world,"paused") then return end
    local seen=current.animation_seen or {};current.animation_seen=seen
    local records=current.animation_records or {};current.animation_records=records
    local victims=current.animation_victims or {};current.animation_victims=victims
    table.clear(seen);table.clear(victims)
    Native.begin()
    for unit,record in pairs(current.moves)do
        if ALIVE[unit] then
            local brain=record.brain
            local rate=current:animation_rate(brain)
            if rate~=1 then
                add(current,unit,rate,brain)
                local pad=brain and brain._scratchpad
                local victim=pad and (pad.grabbed_target or pad.grabbed_unit or pad.target_unit
                    or pad.pounce_component and pad.pounce_component.pounce_target
                    or pad.perception_component and pad.perception_component.target_unit)

    end
    for unit in pairs(records)do if not seen[unit] then records[unit]=nil end end
    table.clear(victims)
    Native.commit()
    return true
end
function A.after()
    Native.finish()
end
return A

-- Per-owner native animation dt. Worker threads execute only native code;
-- they never call Lua, inspect Lua tables or allocate through the Lua VM.
local Guard=require("./native_clock.lua")
local M={}
local signatures={
    {0x5a30e0,"488bc44c89401855488da8b8f6ffff4881ec400a000048895810488970f04889"},
    {0x5a3d80,"488bc455488da828f7ffff4881ecd009000048895810488970f0488bf1488978"},
    {0x60ce80,"4053415641574881eca000000083b9a8000000004c8bf9440f29542430440f28"},
    {0x60d2d0,"4c8bdc5553415441564157498dabb8feffff4881ec20020000448b71384533ff"},

local function bytes(hex)return (hex:gsub("%s",""):gsub("..",function(v)return string.char(tonumber(v,16))end))end

function M.cdef(ffi)
    if pcall(ffi.typeof,"HCMNativeStepState170") then return end
    ffi.cdef[[
        typedef struct { uintptr_t object; float rate; uint32_t hits; } HCMNativeStepEntry170;
        typedef struct { volatile long active; uint32_t mask; HCMNativeStepEntry170 *entries;
            uint32_t trace; uint32_t reserved; } HCMNativeStepState170;
        typedef struct { uint32_t BeginAddress, EndAddress, UnwindData; } HCMNativeStepUnwind170;
        void *VirtualAlloc(void *, size_t, uint32_t, uint32_t);
        int VirtualProtect(void *, size_t, uint32_t, uint32_t *);
        int VirtualFree(void *, size_t, uint32_t);
        void *GetCurrentProcess(void);
        int FlushInstructionCache(void *, const void *, size_t);
        uint32_t GetModuleFileNameA(void *, char *, uint32_t);
        unsigned char RtlAddFunctionTable(HCMNativeStepUnwind170 *, uint32_t, uint64_t);
        unsigned char RtlDeleteFunctionTable(HCMNativeStepUnwind170 *);
        int MH_Initialize(void);
        int MH_CreateHook(void *, void *, void **);
        int MH_RemoveHook(void *);
        int MH_QueueEnableHook(void *);
        int MH_QueueDisableHook(void *);
        int MH_ApplyQueued(void);
    ]]
end

-- A leaf detour preserves the argument registers and changes only XMM1 (dt),
-- then tail-jumps to MinHook's original-function trampoline. Hash entries are
-- immutable while workers run. Unwind metadata accounts for its 32-byte frame.
function M.stub(ffi,state,trampoline,mask)
    local code,labels,fixups="",{},{}
    local function emit(hex)code=code..bytes(hex)end
    local function address(value)
        local storage=ffi.new("uintptr_t[1]",ffi.cast("uintptr_t",value))
        code=code..ffi.string(storage,8)
    end
    local function jump(op,label)emit(op);fixups[#fixups+1]={#code+1,label};code=code.."\0"end
    emit("48 83 ec 20 48 89 04 24 4c 89 54 24 08 4c 89 5c 24 10 49 ba");address(state)
    emit("41 83 3a 00");jump("74","done")
    emit("49 89 cb 49 c1 eb 04")
    labels.probe=#code
    emit("45 23 5a 04 4c 89 d8 48 c1 e0 04 49 03 42 08 48 39 08");jump("74","found")
    emit("48 83 38 00");jump("74","done")
    emit("41 ff c3");jump("eb","probe")
    labels.found=#code
    emit("f3 0f 59 48 08 41 83 7a 10 00");jump("74","done")
    emit("f0 83 48 0c");code=code..string.char(mask)
    labels.done=#code
    emit("48 8b 04 24 4c 8b 54 24 08 4c 8b 5c 24 10 48 83 c4 20 ff 25 00 00 00 00")

    address(trampoline)

-- This constructor is exercised against owned executable test functions.
-- Production passes only targets whose original image bytes were verified.
function M.create_driver(ffi,kernel,hooks,targets)
    M.cdef(ffi)
    local driver={abi=1,ffi=ffi,kernel=kernel,hooks=hooks,targets=targets,pages={},tables={}}
    driver.state=ffi.new("HCMNativeStepState170[1]")

    -- for the process lifetime, including after disabling this condition.
    -- A worker leaving a disabled detour must never jump into freed memory.
    function driver:install()
        if self.installed then return true end
        if self.install_error then return nil,self.install_error end
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            for i,target in ipairs(self.targets)do
                local page=kernel.VirtualAlloc(nil,4096,0x3000,0x40)
                assert(page~=nil,"native clock code allocation failed")
                self.pages[i]=page
                local original=ffi.new("void *[1]")
                local result=hooks.MH_CreateHook(target,page,original)
                assert(result==0,"native clock hook creation failed: "..result)
                local code,length=M.stub(ffi,self.state,original[0],2^(i-1))
                ffi.copy(page,code,#code)
                local ptr=ffi.cast("uint8_t *",page)

                local table=ffi.new("HCMNativeStepUnwind170[1]")

                self.tables[i]=table
                assert(kernel.RtlAddFunctionTable(table,1,ffi.cast("uint64_t",page))~=0,"native clock unwind registration failed")
                local protect=ffi.new("uint32_t[1]")
                assert(kernel.VirtualProtect(page,4096,0x20,protect)~=0,"native clock code protection failed")
                assert(kernel.FlushInstructionCache(kernel.GetCurrentProcess(),page,4096)~=0,"native clock instruction flush failed")
            end

        self.installed=true;return true
    end
    function driver:enable()
        local ok,why=self:install();if not ok then return nil,why end
        for _,target in ipairs(self.targets)do
            local status=hooks.MH_QueueEnableHook(target)
            if status~=0 then return nil,"native clock enable failed: "..status end

    end
    function driver:disable()
        self.state[0].active=0

        local failure
        for _,target in ipairs(self.targets)do
            local status=hooks.MH_QueueDisableHook(target)
            if status~=0 then failure=failure or status end
        end
        local status=hooks.MH_ApplyQueued()
        failure=failure or (status~=0 and status or nil)
        self.enabled=failure~=nil

    end

        assert(self.enabled,"native clock hooks are inactive")
        self.state[0].active=0
        ffi.fill(self.entries,ffi.sizeof(self.entries))
        self.count=0;self.state[0].trace=self.traced and 0 or 1
    end
    function driver:add(object,rate)
        assert(self.state[0].active==0,"cannot mutate an active native clock map")
        assert(type(rate)=="number" and rate==rate and rate>0 and rate<64,"invalid native clock rate")
        assert(object~=nil and self.count<16384,"native clock binding capacity exceeded")
        local key=ffi.cast("uintptr_t",object)
        local slot=math.floor(tonumber(key)/16)%32768
        while self.entries[slot].object~=0 and self.entries[slot].object~=key do slot=(slot+1)%32768 end
        if self.entries[slot].object==0 then self.count=self.count+1 end
        self.entries[slot].object=key;self.entries[slot].rate=rate
        return slot
    end
    function driver:commit()
        -- x64 stores are ordered; publication is the last store. World.update
        -- is synchronous and joins its animation jobs before finish/begin.
        self.state[0].active=1
    end
    function driver:finish()
        self.state[0].active=0
    end
    return driver
end

function M.library_path(executable)
    local binaries=executable:match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$")
    local root=binaries and binaries:match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$")
    assert(root and root~="","native hook library root unavailable")

end
local driver,ffi

end
function M.bind(unit,rate,record)
    local binding,why=Guard.bind(unit,record)
    if not binding then return nil,why end
    binding.instance_slot=driver:add(binding.instance,rate)
    binding.blender_slot=driver:add(binding.blender,rate)

function M.commit()Guard.end_frame();driver:commit()end
function M.finish()if driver then driver:finish()end end
function M.observed(binding)
    if not driver or driver.traced then return end
    local a=driver.entries[binding.instance_slot].hits
    local b=driver.entries[binding.blender_slot].hits
    return a~=0 and b==12,a,b
end
function M.complete_trace()driver.traced=true end

-- Read-only unit-owner guard for the native timestep hooks, audited on 1.12.5.
-- No animation layers or playback times are read or written here.
-- Build and pointer checks fail closed; an engine update needs a new audit.
local M={}
local signatures={
    {0x5390f7,"488bc8c1e90281f9ffff0100741f8bc1c1e91125ffff010048c1e00448030546d1db00390875064c8b7008eb034d8bf7"},
    {0x53926b,"4d8b8e68020000498b4130448b7008"},
}

-- The constructor also accepts an isolated memory reader for
-- regression tests. Production always supplies VirtualQuery and the image.
function M.create(ffi,base,readable,reset_reader)
    local byte=ffi.typeof("uint8_t *")
    local uint32,uint16=ffi.typeof("uint32_t *"),ffi.typeof("uint16_t *")
    local address=ffi.typeof("uintptr_t *")
    local carrier,low32=ffi.typeof("uintptr_t"),ffi.typeof("uint32_t")
    local function ptr(p)return ffi.cast(byte,p)end
    base=ptr(base)
    local function u32(p,o)return tonumber(ffi.cast(uint32,p+o)[0])end
    local function pointer(p,o)return ptr(ffi.cast(address,p+o)[0])end
    local function encode(unit)return tonumber(ffi.cast(low32,ffi.cast(carrier,unit)))end
    if not readable(base,0x40) or u32(base,0)%0x10000~=0x5a4d then return nil,"invalid executable image" end
    local pe=u32(base,0x3c)
    if pe>0x1000 or not readable(base+pe,0x90) or u32(base,pe)~=0x4550
        or u32(base,pe+8)~=1786450566 or u32(base,pe+0x50)~=41992192
        or tonumber(ffi.cast(uint16,base+pe+0x18)[0])~=0x20b then
        return nil,"unsupported game executable; expected audited 1.12.5 build"
    end
    for _,spec in ipairs(signatures)do
        local expected=spec[2]:gsub("..",function(h)return string.char(tonumber(h,16))end)
        if not readable(base+spec[1],#expected) or ffi.string(base+spec[1],#expected)~=expected then
            return nil,string.format("engine signature mismatch at RVA %x",spec[1])
        end
    end
    if not readable(base+0x12f6260,8) then return nil,"unit registry unavailable" end
    local clock={base=base}
    local active=false
    function clock.begin_frame()
        active=true
        if reset_reader then reset_reader(true)end
    end
    function clock.end_frame()
        active=false
        if reset_reader then reset_reader(false)end
    end
    -- Resolve only the two native animation owners. The timestep path does
    -- not inspect, read back or seek individual layers.
    function clock.bind(unit,context)
        if not active then return nil,"clock pass inactive" end
        if type(unit)~="userdata" and type(unit)~="cdata" then return nil,"invalid unit reference" end
        local ok,encoded=pcall(encode,unit)
        if not ok then return nil,"unit reference conversion failed" end
        local ref=math.floor(encoded/4);local index=ref%0x20000
        if index==0x1ffff then return nil,"invalid unit index" end
        local registry=pointer(base,0x12f6260);local entry=registry+index*16
        if not readable(registry,16) or not readable(entry,16) or u32(entry,0)~=math.floor(ref/0x20000) then return nil,"expired unit generation" end
        local object=pointer(entry,8)
        if not readable(object,0x270) then return nil,"unit unavailable" end
        local instance,blender=pointer(object,0x268),pointer(object,0x260)
        if not readable(instance,0x58) or not readable(blender,0xf0) then return nil,"animation owners unavailable" end
        local resource=pointer(instance,0x30)
        if not readable(resource,12) or u32(resource,8)<1 or u32(resource,8)>32
            or u32(instance,0x50)~=u32(resource,8) or pointer(instance,0x40)~=blender then return nil,"animation owner layout mismatch" end
        context=context or {}
        context.instance,context.blender=instance,blender
        return context
    end
    return clock
end

-- Cache OS memory-region permissions only during one synchronous binding pass.
-- Live values (generation, pointers and counts) are
-- still read each time. Clear before returning to any native world update.
function M.memory_reader(ffi,query,info)
    local uintptr=ffi.typeof("uintptr_t")
    -- Cache complete VirtualQuery regions, not just the page that happened
    -- to be queried. Unit/instance/blender arenas are interleaved in-game.
    local starts,ends={},{}
    local count=0
    local stats={queries=0,regions=0}
    local caching,last_start,last_end=false,0,0
    local function reset(enabled)
        for i=1,count do starts[i]=nil;ends[i]=nil end
        count=0
        if enabled then stats.queries=0;stats.regions=0 end
        caching=enabled;last_start,last_end=0,0
    end
    local function readable(address,size)
        local n=tonumber(ffi.cast(uintptr,address))
        if n<0x10000 or size<0 or n+size>=0x800000000000 then return false end
        if caching then
            if n>=last_start and n+size<=last_end then return true end
            local low,high=1,count
            while low<=high do
                local mid=math.floor((low+high)/2)
                if starts[mid]>n then high=mid-1
                elseif ends[mid]<=n then low=mid+1
                else
                    if n+size<=ends[mid] then last_start,last_end=starts[mid],ends[mid];return true end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        stats.queries=stats.queries+1
        if query(address,info,48)~=48 then return false end
        local p=tonumber(info[0].protect)
        local access=p%0x100
        local start=tonumber(ffi.cast(uintptr,info[0].base))
        local finish=start+tonumber(info[0].size)
        local valid=info[0].state==0x1000 and p%0x200<0x100
            and (access==2 or access==4 or access==8 or access==0x20 or access==0x40 or access==0x80)
            and n>=start and n+size<=finish
        if valid and caching then
            last_start,last_end=start,finish
            local index=count+1
            while index>1 and starts[index-1]>start do
                starts[index],ends[index]=starts[index-1],ends[index-1];index=index-1
            end
            starts[index],ends[index]=start,finish
            count=count+1;stats.regions=count
        end
        return valid
    end
    return readable,reset,stats
end

local instance,reason,attempted
function M.available()
    if attempted then return instance~=nil,reason end
    attempted=true
    local ok,result,why=pcall(function()
        local ffi=Mods and Mods.lua and Mods.lua.ffi or require("ffi")
        if not ffi or ffi.os~="Windows" or not ffi.abi("64bit") then return nil,"Windows x64 LuaJIT FFI required" end
        if not pcall(ffi.typeof,"HCMFrenzyMemoryInfo164") then
            ffi.cdef[[
                typedef struct { void *base; void *allocation; uint32_t allocation_protect;
                    uint16_t partition; uint16_t padding; size_t size; uint32_t state;
                    uint32_t protect; uint32_t type; uint32_t tail; } HCMFrenzyMemoryInfo164;
                void *GetModuleHandleA(const char *name);
                size_t VirtualQuery(const void *address, void *buffer, size_t length);
            ]]
        end
        local kernel=ffi.load("kernel32")
        local info=ffi.new("HCMFrenzyMemoryInfo164[1]")
        assert(ffi.sizeof(info)==48,"unexpected memory-info layout")
        local readable,reset,stats=M.memory_reader(ffi,kernel.VirtualQuery,info)
        local clock,why=M.create(ffi,kernel.GetModuleHandleA(nil),readable,reset)
        if clock then clock.stats=stats end
        return clock,why
    end)
    if ok then instance,reason=result,why else reason=tostring(result)end
    return instance~=nil,reason
end
function M.begin_frame()if instance then instance.begin_frame()end end
function M.end_frame()if instance then instance.end_frame()end end
function M.bind(...)return instance.bind(...)end
function M.image_base()return instance and instance.base end
function M.frame_stats()return instance and instance.stats end
return M
